title: CITYVENTORY
description:
CITYVENTORY is a unique city builder game with a fresh perspective. Unlike traditional city builders, you can freely move and reposition your tiles at any time! However, careful planning is still essential, as any unused tiles are lost when the round ends.

The main objective in CITYVENTORY is to synergize tiles to maximize your score. Some tiles have synergies, offering bonus points when placed together. For example, mills gain additional points for each adjacent farm, and farms also boost each other’s points. However, mills have a negative synergy with other mills, so placing two mills next to each other will cause you to lose points.

Once you reach the required points to advance to the next goal, you unlock a new tile type to expand your synergy opportunities. You’ll be able to choose from three available tiles to add to your tile pool and you’ll also receive one guaranteed copy of it. Your choice may depend on the tiles already placed or the terrain features of your city.

When you score enough points to advance to a new stage, you can expand your city, giving you more space to work with. Once your city is fully expanded, continuing to earn points will allow you to unlock larger cities with diverse features and challenges.

• An original mix of city building and inventory management genres

• Rewarding decision making situations

• Variety of tile synergies

• Many unlockable tiles

• Cartoony art style

• High replay value

• Global Leaderboards

• Great for trying and beating your high score
description_short: CITYVENTORY is a minimalist city builder/inventory management game where you build colorful cities just like you are organizing your inventory. Place and move your tiles freely, synergize them to earn points and build the best city possible!
